tasks.final_text: Tower 333 is a 20-story high-rise building in the central business district of Bellevue, Washington, United States. The building housed the corporate office of Expedia, Inc. from 2008 to 2019. Amazon is planned to take over the lease for the entire building in 2020.

Yesterday, my school was cancelled, so I drove to Abu Dhabi to pick up some friends who were stuck in the UAE. It was a nice seven-hour drive. Unfortunately, I did not have WiFi the whole time. I was supposed to attend virtual school, but I did not. I now have to complete all the work I avoided yesterday today. Luckily, school was cancelled today because the US Embassy was attacked.
